answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 7849 Country: India Title: Women keep the roza which are missed in Periods but can they perform the namaz of periods after the mensuration cycle? Question: Women keep the roza which are missed in Periods but can they perform the namaz of periods after the mensuration cycle? Answer ID: 7849 Posted on: Aug 28, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1830/1557=B/1429) She has not to perform the salah missed due to menses; there is no need to perform it later, but a woman has to do qaza of Ramazan fasts when the month of Ramazan is over. This is the ruling of the Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
